title: Decimal place value
objective: Understand Decimal place value through the chapter source and examples.
teacher_explanation: Digits after the decimal represent tenths, hundredths, thousandths, etc.

title: Division by powers of ten
objective: Understand Division by powers of ten through the chapter source and examples.
teacher_explanation: Dividing by 10,100,1000 shifts the decimal left by the number of zeroes.

title: Decimal multiplication
objective: Understand Decimal multiplication through the chapter source and examples.
teacher_explanation: Multiply as integers/fractions and place the decimal using total decimal digits.

title: Products below one
objective: Understand Products below one through the chapter source and examples.
teacher_explanation: A product need not be larger than both factors.

title: Decimal division
objective: Understand Decimal division through the chapter source and examples.
teacher_explanation: Use fractions, powers of ten, or long division to divide decimals.

title: Long division with decimal quotient
objective: Understand Long division with decimal quotient through the chapter source and examples.
teacher_explanation: Place value regrouping extends to quotients with decimals.
